name: confirmDailyCheckins
description: Save only the linked caller's explicit call or family-sharing choices. These are independent: declining or pausing calls does not revoke sharing. Omit choices the caller has not made. Never infer a refusal from silence. Use accepted to resume, declined to stop, paused to pause. For a dated pause use an ISO timestamp including timezone based on their explicit answer; omit pause_until for an indefinite pause. Keep private reasons out of tool arguments. Use saveCallingPreference for confirmed schedule changes. Confirm only after success.

allow_calls.description: Legacy optional equivalent of accepted/declined. Prefer call_status. Omit if call preference was not discussed.

allow_reports.description: Independent permission for short family updates, including ordinary chats, reminders and call-preference status. True only on explicit agreement, false on explicit refusal or revocation; OMIT if not discussed.

call_status.description: Only an explicit caller choice. accepted allows their confirmed schedule; declined stops friendly calls; paused pauses friendly calls. Omit if not discussed.

pause_until.description: For paused calls only: exact future ISO 8601 timestamp WITH timezone offset confirmed by caller; omitted means indefinite. Never guess the date or timezone.
